name: Mikami Makoto
source:
An upbeat, funny college student. He was attacked by piglets right before the opening ceremony, and left tied up in a storage room. There's something mysterious about him, and he seems to enjoy watching the protagonist and her friends play the games.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com]official website[/url]]
